_design_notes: Diagnostic collection of full native DuckDB SQL, including OpenIVM internal helper connections. These instrumented timings are not performance baselines.
Same TPC-DI workload as PR86: one repetition, inserts 100/1/0.01, no synthetic updates/deletes, serial execution, SF100 unvalidated and separate SF10 exact validation.
OPENIVM_QUERY_LOG enables the native-only CLI wrapper; complete input and executed SQL are exported after every batch without truncation.
